name: 25341-randomchat-qwen3next80b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, four GPUs of one a3 node, in one allocation.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, multiprocess executor. Four 80 GB cards is the fewest that hold ~163 GB of bf16 weights, at ~41 GiB each.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=32, bounded at 192 requests / 120 s safety, first 32 completions warmup and last 10% cooldown by completion. A closed loop at 32 streams issues its first 32 requests simultaneously against a server that has served nothing, so one full wave is transient by construction; the warmup is one wave for that reason.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 1024 tokens (min = max = 1024) and output exactly 128 (min = max = 128), posted to the chat-completions endpoint as one user message at `temperature: 0.0`. Prompts are Faker-generated synthetic English.
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant for 32 concurrent users, handling page-length prompts with short replies on four GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 4
no-enable-prefix-caching: true
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
enable-chunked-prefill: true
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
